title: Jesus... Everyone Went Home For The Holidays Except Me
topic: alone in the hostel during the festival holidays

bible.text: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... everyone in my hostel went home for the holidays. I'm the only one left. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: The mess is closed. I ate biscuits for dinner and told my mom I had a proper meal.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You said that so she wouldn't worry. That's love, even when it's lonely.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Ten days of an empty corridor. Nobody would even notice if I didn't come out of my room.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I would notice. I'm in that corridor with you. You're not as unseen as it feels right now.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why is my phone so quiet? Not one message all day.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Because they all think you're fine. You don't have to keep pretending. Send one honest text today. Just tell someone you're still here.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That prayer is in the Bible. You're allowed to pray it too, out loud, in that empty room.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Who's the one person you'd text if you were alone tonight? 🙏
